text: In January 1972, during [the Vietnam War|wrong|war and atrocity], a radio transmission arrives from R-Point, an island near Saigon where a South Korean platoon went missing, and Lieutenant Choi leads [a squad of soldiers|who_suffers|people at work] to bring them back within a week. Near their base [a deserted French plantation|threat|evil places] appears, a corporal meets soldiers he mistakes for the lost unit, and American visitors warn them to touch nothing on the second floor. Then [Private Jung is found hanged|images|ropes, cages and executions], and headquarters reveals that he was one of the missing men they came to rescue.
